description: This file implements functions related to scheduling PUSCH time domain resources in LTE/5G NR, handling both FDD and TDD modes, including resource index calculations, fairness distribution, and slot-specific resource list generation.

methods.name: get_min_k1
methods.description: Calculates the minimum k1 value based on downlink data acknowledgment and search space info.

methods.name: get_pusch_time_domain_resource_table
methods.description: Returns the appropriate PUSCH time domain resource list based on search space info.

methods.name: get_fdd_pusch_td_resource_indices
methods.description: Determines PUSCH time domain resource indices for FDD mode based on k2 and min_k1.

methods.name: is_dl_enabled_slot
methods.description: Checks if a given slot has active downlink symbols based on TDD configuration.

methods.name: get_pusch_td_resource_indices
methods.description: Main function to get PUSCH resource indices for a specific slot, handling both FDD and TDD modes.

methods.name: get_pusch_td_resource_indices_per_slot
methods.description: Generates a list of applicable PUSCH resource indices per slot considering TDD configurations.

methods.name: find_td_index_with_k2
methods.description: Finds the index of a PUSCH resource with a specific k2 value within a list.

methods.name: get_fairly_distributed_pusch_td_resource_indices
methods.description: Distributes PUSCH resources fairly across slots, considering TDD patterns and slot types.
